item.title: ST-001
item.description:
Model ST-001 - Sliding Track

Product Overview

Smooth sliding track system for drawers, wardrobes, and sliding doors with quiet operation.

Key Features

  • Smooth gliding action
  • Heavy-duty load capacity
  • Quiet operation
  • Easy installation
  • Durable construction

Technical Specifications

Specification Details
Model Number ST-001
Material Aluminum Alloy / Steel
Surface Finish Anodized / Powder Coated
Load Capacity Up to 50kg per meter
Length Customizable lengths
Weight 0.8-1.5kg per meter

Why Choose This Sliding Track ST-001?

  • Premium Aluminum Alloy / Steel Construction — Made from selected aluminum alloy / steel, ensuring long service life even in demanding environments.
  • Versatile Finish Options — Available in anodized / powder coated to match any architectural style and preference.
  • Wide Application Range — Perfectly suited for drawers, wardrobes, sliding doors, providing reliable performance.
  • Factory Direct Pricing — As an ISO 9001 certified manufacturer, we offer competitive pricing without middlemen markup.
  • Quality Assurance — Each piece undergoes 100% inspection before packaging. Salt spray tested for corrosion resistance.

Shipping & Packaging Details

All products are professionally packaged for export. Standard export carton with individual bubble wrap protection. FOB Yiwu / Shanghai port. Sample orders dispatched within 3-5 days via international express (DHL/FedEx/UPS). Bulk orders shipped within 15-25 days by sea.
